name: Xiaohongshu Accounts
description: Manage multiple Xiaohongshu accounts in Vetta and run MCP tasks concurrently through the account selected for each task.
mcp.name: Xiaohongshu tools
mcp.description: Run Xiaohongshu search, note and interaction operations for a selected account; omit account_id to use the active account.
setup.title: Xiaohongshu sign-in
setup.subtitle: The plugin owns login sessions and does not write to the user's global MCP configuration.
setup.waitingScan: Scan with Xiaohongshu to sign in
setup.identityPendingHint: Signed in, but the upstream service has not returned a nickname yet
accounts.title: Xiaohongshu accounts
accounts.subtitle: Switching accounts safely restarts the service; requests resume after the switch.
accounts.securityHint: Sessions are isolated and stored by the plugin
accounts.savedSubtitle: Each account has an isolated session, so switching will not overwrite the others.
accounts.addFirst: Scan to add your first account
accounts.removeConfirm: Remove “{{name}}”? This deletes the locally saved login session.
accounts.renamePlaceholder: Enter nickname or remark (e.g., Creator Account)
accounts.deleteWarning: Are you sure you want to remove “{{name}}”? The local session cache will be deleted and you will need to scan again.
accounts.qrDialogSubtitle: Scan the QR code below with your Xiaohongshu mobile app to authorize
accounts.qrStep2: Tap the scan icon in the search bar or top menu
accounts.qrStep3: Scan the QR code and confirm sign-in
accounts.emptyDesc: Once connected, the Agent can seamlessly use Xiaohongshu MCP tools to search popular notes, analyze engagement trends, and gather creative ideas.
